resources.string: Search works offline in your active imported database. Return to the library to import or select one.

Search words throughout the selected sources, including prose and purports. Common spellings also match (Krishna finds Kṛṣṇa, Chaitanya finds Caitanya); end a word with * to match any ending (bhakt* finds bhakta, bhakti…). A reference such as BG 2.8 or Madhya 1.1 opens that verse.
Search the original verse and transliteration, not translations or purports.
Find a verse by reference, such as BG 2.8 or Madhya 1.1.
All words must occur in the same paragraph, in any order. Matching ignores case and Latin accents, accepts common spellings (Krishna, Vishnu, Arjun) and word* endings.
Words must occur together in the same order, in one paragraph. Matching ignores case and Latin accents, accepts common spellings and word* endings.
Loading books and collections. You can still search the current scope.
Finding this book in your library…
The scope picker could not load. You can retry it or try searching the current scope.
Suggestions are unavailable. You can still submit your search.
Remove search history for this database only? Your books and other databases are unchanged.
Source order · Count includes loaded passages only.
Try fewer or different words, or end a word with * to match any ending (bhakt*). If you selected books, broaden the scope to All database, then search again.
No verified passages in the records checked so far. More candidates remain; continue searching with Show more.
Use 1–8 searchable words and no more than 160 characters, or enter a source reference such as BG 2.8.
The search did not finish. Any passages shown are verified, but the search is incomplete. Retry, narrow the scope, or use more specific words.
The active database could not be searched. Try again, or return to the library to check the selected database. This does not mean there are no matches.
Search all text in the active library.
Select a parent to include all its nested sources, even when hidden. Use arrows to expand or collapse each level.
No sources selected. Select at least one, or explicitly choose All database.
%1$d selected roots, including hidden descendants. A partial mark means only some content is selected. Changes take effect only after Apply.

Excluding a nested source keeps the remaining sibling branches. Prose belonging only to the removed parent or intermediate containers is also excluded: it cannot be selected separately in this catalog.
Matching nested sources are revealed while filtering
No individual sources are available. All database is still an option.
No sources match this filter. Existing selections are unchanged.
